note: The first-run tips: small cards that appear one at a time as you play, each once (src/core/tutorial.js). A tip shows when one of its `when` entries holds: an event the game fired (`event`), seconds of play (`time`), another tip already seen (`after`), the nearest target's id (`nearId`, exact or a prefix ending in ':') or standing within `r` metres of a point in the town (`at`). At least `timing.gap` seconds separate two tips unless a tip's own `gap` says less, and a tip hides after `timing.show` seconds. `done` is what the player does to finish it early (if they did it before the tip showed, it never shows). `where` puts a route on the minimap while the tip is up. {anywhere}, {desk} and {hallNew} are filled in from balance.json by cardCoins(); keys are named by action ({interact}, {collect}, see keys.json) and show the player's own binding. `drag` replaces the wording of a tip while the mouse setting is 拖动转视角. Instruction text, like mission text, has no voice clip.

skipped.zh: 教程已跳过。想再看，就去设置里重新开始。
skipped.en: Tutorial skipped. Replay it any time from Settings.

arrival.zh: 第一次来？出发以后，新手教程会一步一步带你玩。
arrival.en: First time here? Short tips appear as you play.

steps.zh: 点一下画面，再移动鼠标，看看四周。
steps.pinyin: Diǎn yíxià huàmiàn, zài yídòng shǔbiāo, kànkan sìzhōu.
steps.en: Click the town, then move the mouse to look around. On a touch screen, drag with a finger.

drag.zh: 按住鼠标左键拖动，就可以转动视角。
drag.pinyin: Ànzhù shǔbiāo zuǒjiàn tuōdòng, jiù kěyǐ zhuàndòng shìjiǎo.
drag.en: Hold the left mouse button and drag to look around. On a touch screen, drag with a finger.

steps.zh: 按 {forward} {left} {back} {right} 走几步。按住 Shift 可以走得快一点。
steps.pinyin: Àn {forward} {left} {back} {right} zǒu jǐ bù. Ànzhù Shift kěyǐ zǒu de kuài yìdiǎn.
steps.en: Walk a few steps with {forward} {left} {back} {right}. Hold Shift to walk faster.

steps.zh: 按 {view} 换成第三人称，就能看见自己。再按一次就换回来了。
steps.pinyin: Àn {view} huànchéng dì-sān rénchēng, jiù néng kànjiàn zìjǐ. Zài àn yí cì jiù huàn huílái le.
steps.en: Press {view} to switch to third person and see yourself. Press it again to switch back.

steps.zh: 把准星对准一样东西，看到它的名字以后按 {collect}，这个词就记下来了。
steps.pinyin: Bǎ zhǔnxīng duìzhǔn yí yàng dōngxi, kàndào tā de míngzi yǐhòu àn {collect}, zhège cí jiù jì xiàlái le.
steps.en: Aim the crosshair at something. When its name appears, press {collect} to keep the word.

steps.zh: 按 {wordbank} 打开生词本。你记下来的词都在这里，随时可以复习。
steps.pinyin: Àn {wordbank} dǎkāi shēngcíběn. Nǐ jì xiàlái de cí dōu zài zhèlǐ, suíshí kěyǐ fùxí.
steps.en: Press {wordbank} to open your word bank. Every word you keep is here, ready to review.

steps.zh: 复习的时候答对了，就能拿到学习币：随身复习每张 +{anywhere}，在家里的书桌前 +{desk}，在词语馆学新词每个 +{hallNew}。
steps.pinyin: Fùxí de shíhou dá duì le, jiù néng nádào xuéxíbì: suíshēn fùxí měi zhāng +{anywhere}, zài jiā lǐ de shūzhuō qián +{desk}, zài cíyǔguǎn xué xīn cí měi ge +{hallNew}.
steps.en: Right answers earn study coins: {anywhere} a card on the go, {desk} at the study desk at home, {hallNew} per new word at the word hall. Coins pay for everything in town.

steps.zh: 左上角是你的任务。点一个任务，小地图上就会出现一条虚线，带你过去。
steps.pinyin: Zuǒshàngjiǎo shì nǐ de rènwu. Diǎn yí ge rènwu, xiǎo dìtú shàng jiù huì chūxiàn yì tiáo xūxiàn, dài nǐ guòqù.
steps.en: Your missions are in the card at the top left. Click one and a dashed line on the minimap leads you there.

steps.zh: 跟人说话的时候，先听，再用中文回答。听不懂就点 ?，看看拼音和英文。
steps.pinyin: Gēn rén shuōhuà de shíhou, xiān tīng, zài yòng Zhōngwén huídá. Tīng bù dǒng jiù diǎn ?, kànkan pīnyīn hé Yīngwén.
steps.en: In a conversation, listen first, then answer in Chinese. Stuck? Tap ? for the pinyin and English. It pays a few coins less, and that is fine.

steps.zh: 去茶铺找林阿姨。走到她面前，按 {interact} 跟她打个招呼。
steps.pinyin: Qù chápù zhǎo Lín āyí. Zǒu dào tā miànqián, àn {interact} gēn tā dǎ ge zhāohu.
steps.en: Find Auntie Lin at the tea stall. Walk up to her and press {interact} to say hello.

steps.zh: 你的家就在莲池公园大门旁边，家门朝着大门。跟着虚线走到门口，按 {interact} 进去。
steps.pinyin: Nǐ de jiā jiù zài Liánchí Gōngyuán dàmén pángbiān, jiāmén cháozhe dàmén. Gēnzhe xūxiàn zǒu dào ménkǒu, àn {interact} jìnqù.
steps.en: Your home is just inside the park's town gate, its door facing the gate. Follow the dashed line to the door and press {interact}.

steps.zh: 这是你的家。书桌可以复习，床可以睡觉，里面还有厨房。门边的海报上写着怎么玩。
steps.pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ de jiā. Shūzhuō kěyǐ fùxí, chuáng kěyǐ shuìjiào, lǐmiàn hái yǒu chúfáng. Ménbiān de hǎibào shàng xiězhe zěnme wán.
steps.en: This is your home. Review at the study desk ({desk} coins a card), sleep in the bed, cook in the kitchen through the side door. The poster by the door explains how things work.

steps.zh: 你会饿，也会累。按 {status} 看看自己的状态。饿了就吃点东西，累了就回家睡一觉。
steps.pinyin: Nǐ huì è, yě huì lèi. Àn {status} kànkan zìjǐ de zhuàngtài. È le jiù chī diǎn dōngxi, lèi le jiù huí jiā shuì yí jiào.
steps.en: You get hungry and tired, and both slow you down. Press {status} to check how you are. Eat when hungry; go home and sleep when tired.

steps.zh: 买东西的时候，走到柜台前按 {interact}。陈叔叔的小摊可以讲价。做饭或者工地缺材料，就点「哪儿有卖」，地图会告诉你去哪儿买。
steps.pinyin: Mǎi dōngxi de shíhou, zǒu dào guìtái qián àn {interact}. Chén shūshu de xiǎotān kěyǐ jiǎngjià. Zuò fàn huòzhě gōngdì quē cáiliào, jiù diǎn “Nǎr yǒu mài”, dìtú huì gàosu nǐ qù nǎr mǎi.
steps.en: To buy something, walk up to the counter and press {interact}. Uncle Chen's stall lets you haggle. Short of something for a recipe or a build site? Tap 哪儿有卖 and the map shows where to buy it.

steps.zh: 广场南边有莲池公园，穿过月亮门就到了。广场西边还有小吃摊，卖馄饨、面条和包子。
steps.pinyin: Guǎngchǎng nánbian yǒu Liánchí Gōngyuán, chuānguò yuèliangmén jiù dào le. Guǎngchǎng xībian hái yǒu xiǎochītān, mài húntun, miàntiáo hé bāozi.
steps.en: Lotus Pond Park is just south of the square: walk through the moon gate. Snack stalls on the west side sell wontons, noodles and steamed buns.

steps.zh: 别的街区有门。认识的词够多了，门就会开。在词语馆复习 HSK 的词，或者用 {collect} 记住看到的东西，两种都算。
steps.pinyin: Bié de jiēqū yǒu mén. Rènshi de cí gòu duō le, mén jiù huì kāi. Zài cíyǔguǎn fùxí HSK de cí, huòzhě yòng {collect} jìzhù kàndào de dōngxi, liǎng zhǒng dōu suàn.
steps.en: The other districts are behind gates that open once you know enough words. Drilling HSK words at the word hall and pressing {collect} on things around town both count.

steps.zh: 教程结束了！按 {journal} 打开旅行手册，看看今天的日常小事。祝你玩得开心！
steps.pinyin: Jiàochéng jiéshù le! Àn {journal} dǎkāi lǚxíng shǒucè, kànkan jīntiān de rìcháng xiǎoshì. Zhù nǐ wán de kāixīn!
steps.en: That is the tutorial! Press {journal} to open your travel journal and see today's daily errands. Have fun!
